content: Now I'll write and execute the SQL query to calculate salary percentiles for employees in the specified departments.

arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    Department,
    LastName,
    Rate,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY Department ORDER BY Rate DESC) AS CumulativeDistribution,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Department ORDER BY Rate DESC) AS PercentRank
FROM HumanResources.vemployeedepartmenthistory
WHERE Department IN ('Information Services', 'Document Control')
ORDER BY Department ASC, Rate DESC;
